evals.name: Generate mobile screen from Stitch maquette
evals.prompt: Generate a full mobile screen using Stitch MCP. Use design-system.md. No AI-slop patterns (see anti-ai-patterns.md). Include all 8 states.
evals.expected: Full source code with correct tokens, no slop, all states present.

evals.name: Respect anti-pattern rules
evals.prompt: Generate a screen avoiding purple-indigo hero, identical cards, Inter-only, default gray cards, fade-up scroll, emoji icons, placeholder metrics.
evals.expected: PASS on all 25 anti-pattern checks; real content.

evals.name: Fidelity verification
evals.prompt: After generation, compare against Stitch reference using fidelity protocol. Report PASS/DIVERGE with measurements.
evals.expected: PASS with measurements, or DIVERGE with specific divergence list.
